title: bromopsis inermis var. aristata
intro: Bromopsis inermis var. aristata, commonly known as Mountain Brome, is a type of grass native to North America. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that can help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Brome include its use as a treatment for respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Brome include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
